summary: Williamson County tower, number 7-2; Tennessee Landforms marks it moved, but gives no year and names no new site.

facts.status_note: Tennessee Landforms lists the tower as moved and names no new site; no source describes the site or the tower today.

events.note: Tennessee Landforms marks the tower moved. No year and no new site are given.

evidence.supports: Table numbers are state forest tower numbers from a 1976 list
evidence.quote: Numbers in the table (e.g., 4-7) are state forest tower numbers (district-tower) from 1976 list of towers

evidence.supports: Many towers removed; most locations are now private property
evidence.quote: Many have been removed, and most locations are now private property

evidence.supports: Division was responsible for building 208 fire lookout towers, about 1930 to 1970
evidence.quote: The TDF was responsible for the construction of 208 fire lookout towers during the period between ca. 1930 and ca. 1970

evidence.supports: Division towers formed its fire detection network between 1933 and 1975
evidence.quote: Collectively, the fire towers formed the physical manifestation of TDF's fire detection network between 1933 and 1975

sources.title: Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers, 1933 to 1975 (National Register multiple property documentation form)

notes_for_editor: Only Tennessee Landforms (waypoint page and table) and the NRHP multiple property form were read for this tower; two web searches found nothing specific to Pewitt. The moved status and the 978 ft elevation come from Landforms. The Division of Forestry link is inferred from the state forest numbering; no source read names the agency for Pewitt. No build year, design, height or staffing appears in any source read. The destination of the move is unknown, so the Landforms waypoint cannot be checked against a new site. The record's status 'relocated' matches Landforms' 'moved'.
